title: the rc1 site bundle's weights and the embedder
note: basis 'shown' means shown by reading the code and by the card's unit tests on stand-ins; nothing was built, fetched or signed for real.

findings.claim: the e-embed-1 row of models/registry.yaml names its repository, revision and expected manifest digest but no expected.source: no committed record lists the embedder's 18 files (path, bytes, sha256); the list lives only in the bucket (r2/models/e-embed-1.sha256), so tools/fetch_weights.py --embedder stops with exit 2 and cannot fill a models folder for a site bundle

which key signs the rc1 site bundle is not decided: the release key on the cloud build VM (d_sign, Secret Manager), a throwaway key (validation mode: not a release, refused by a box that trusts the release key), or the release key on a vendor machine (make release-bundle); options and needs on the card's page, section 4

the rc1 bundle's --release-seq is not decided and no record of issued release_seq values exists in the repository; every rc1 site's next update must carry a higher value (tools/verify_update.py:268-283); options on the card's page, section 4

not verified: the box run's start route still binds the VM's /models over deploy/models (d_models_place) when it installs a bundle that now carries the weights; whether the bundle's models and the bind agree was not checked (no real bundle was built)
